title: PayGuard AI Shared Event Contract
description: Shared event schema for Blue guard, Red attacker, collector, and dashboard. All services post events to this format.

kind.description: CRITICAL: these three events are SEPARATE and must never be conflated: POLICY_APPROVED (guard allowed), SIGNER_CALLED (wallet sign invoked), CHAIN_TRANSFERRED (chain balance changed)

layer.description: Guard layer that produced this event (L0-L8)

detail.description: Sanitized detail — MUST NOT contain private keys or signing secrets

pin_hash.description: sha256: prefixed hash of the pinned quote — never the raw quote

trace_id.description: Correlation ID across layers for one payment attempt

amount_atomic.description: Payment amount in atomic USDC units (6 decimals). Never a USD float.

merchant.description: Merchant host or origin — never full URL with credentials

attack.description: Attack ID if from Red team (A1-A18)

chain_delta_atomic.description: Actual balance delta from mock chain (negative = paid out). Set by L7 only.

funds_lost_atomic.description: Funds lost to attacker per chain. Set by mock chain, NOT by the guard.

blue_guard.GET /guard/status: Budget, behaviour stats, pin store size

mock_chain.GET /balance-delta: Balance delta for a given intentId

security_notes: Private keys MUST NEVER appear in event payloads, logs, HTTP responses, or source code.
funds_lost_atomic is set by the mock chain ONLY — never by the guard's own logs.
All amounts are atomic integer strings (BigInt-safe). No USD floats in event data.
